description: Create a Leash app: its own walled-off Postgres schema and sign-in. slug: 2–40 chars, lowercase letters, digits and dashes, starting with a letter. origins: where the web app is served (needed for browser sign-in and CORS). Free allows 1 app, Plus 10, Pro 25.

origins.description: Web origins the app is served from, e.g. https://myapp.example.com or http://localhost:5173 (no path).
